# Pleasant Cove Design

> Midcoast Maine web design studio helping small businesses fix outdated websites, broken contact flows, and weak mobile experiences that cost them customers.

Pleasant Cove Design builds modern, conversion-focused websites and AI receptionist tools for owner-operated businesses across Maine. Based in Newcastle, ME, with focused service across Midcoast Maine, Greater Portland, Southern Maine, Central Maine, and Down East / Bangor.

## Facts

- Name: Pleasant Cove Design
- Based in: Newcastle, Maine (Midcoast Maine)
- Phone: (207) 380-5680
- Email: hello@pleasantcove.design
- Service area: All of Maine, plus remote clients across the United States
- What we do: Small-business website design, redesigns, local SEO, AI phone receptionist, online booking and intake flows, and ongoing care/maintenance plans
- What we don't do: Enterprise applications, large e-commerce catalogs, app development, marketing retainers, or paid-ads management
- Pricing model: One-time build fee ($1,500–$6,500) plus a month-to-month plan — care plans from $125/mo, or full bundles from $395/mo that include AI, booking, and ongoing improvements. No long-term contracts.
- Typical timeline: Most small-business sites launch in 2–4 weeks once content is in hand; targeted fixes can ship in days.
- How most engagements start: A free website review that names the specific issues costing the business customers, with a clear fix plan and no obligation.
